What we do

Software as a service, built around AI agents

AJ House builds applications where AI agents do the heavy lifting and people stay in control of the creative decisions.

01

Autonomous applications

End-to-end AI applications that plan, build and run multi-step workflows, with a human approving what matters.

02

Creative Studio

AI-produced video and content for small and medium businesses: quick, quality, and the client involved from the first draft.

03

Commissioned builds

Custom applications built for businesses on our own foundation, so they get capability without building an engine from scratch.

Next generation content creation

DAiVtube is our AI studio for video. DAiV takes a brief and a handful of pictures and turns them into a finished, branded film: animation, edit, music and graphics.

  • From brief to finished video in minutes, not weeks
  • AI animation from your own pictures and footage
  • Titles, graphics, music and branding in one pass
  • You stay in the creative seat throughout
  • End-to-end AI workload management
  • Self-diagnosis and repair
  • Real-time creative reporting
  • Channel creation and scheduling
